How to use this platform

1. Create free trials on Grok, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini (or any provider).

2. Click + Add Account and paste email + session token / cookies.

3. When a trial dies, mark it Exhausted. The rotator will skip it.

4. Hit Get Next Account to pull the next healthy session.

5. Everything is stored locally in your browser (encrypted-ready structure). Export anytime.

This is the full client-side platform. Backend + automation runners live in the GitHub repo for self-hosting.
